plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Cisco Secure Email Gateway / IronPort ESA appliances (PEN 15497, ASYNCOS-MAIL-MIB). Besides standard IF-MIB 64-bit interface traffic, it collects CPU, memory, disk I/O and work-queue utilization (%) and, on physical appliances, power-supply state, temperature sensors and fan speed.
name: Firewall

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: Uptime of the Cisco ESA appliance since the last restart (IF-MIB sysUpTime), in seconds.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the Cisco ESA appliance (ASYNCOS-MAIL-MIB perCentCPUUtilization, Integer32 percent). Values outside 0-100 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the Cisco ESA appliance (ASYNCOS-MAIL-MIB perCentMemoryUtilization, Integer32 percent). Values outside 0-100 are dropped.

metrics.name: esa_disk_io_usage
metrics.description: Disk I/O utilization of the Cisco ESA appliance (ASYNCOS-MAIL-MIB perCentDiskIOUtilization, Integer32 percent). Values outside 0-100 are dropped.

metrics.name: esa_queue_usage
metrics.description: Work-queue utilization of the Cisco ESA appliance (ASYNCOS-MAIL-MIB perCentQueueUtilization, Integer32 percent). Values outside 0-100 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Power-supply state of the Cisco ESA appliance (ASYNCOS-MAIL-MIB powerSupplyStatus): healthy(2) maps to 1 (normal); notInstalled(1), noAC(3) and faulty(4) map to 2 (abnormal); values not defined in the MIB are dropped.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Chassis temperature of the Cisco ESA appliance in Celsius (ASYNCOS-MAIL-MIB degreesCelsius). Values outside -40 to 125 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_fan_speed
metrics.description: Fan speed of the Cisco ESA appliance in RPM (ASYNCOS-MAIL-MIB fanRPMs). Values below 0, above 30000, or sentinel 4294967295 are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: Average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: Average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter.
